data.name: Scope
data.value: Scope: selected user configuration file only; project, managed and session overrides are not resolved.

data.name: unsupported_setting
data.value: Setting semantics not supported; inspect manually

data.name: unsupported_command
data.value: Launcher or transport not supported; inspect manually

data.name: config_too_large
data.value: Configuration exceeds the 1 MiB read limit

data.name: file_too_large
data.value: Assembly exceeds the 32 MiB read limit

data.name: consistent
data.value: Inspected versions agree; identical code is not established

data.name: ConfigureClient
data.value: Install the validated package, then run --configure --clients {0} --mcp-server <validated executable>.

data.name: InspectClient
data.value: Inspect the NavisHelper entry in the selected client's settings; correct the reported setting/format or use that client's MCP configuration UI.

data.name: RepairInstallation
data.value: Reinstall a validated NavisHelper package with matching plugin and MCP server versions, then configure this client to its executable.

data.name: VerifyBuild
data.value: Compare SHA256 values with the validated package. With a development checkout, run scripts/check_installed_bundle_drift.py; version equality alone does not prove the build is current.

data.name: ReloadClient
data.value: After repairing configuration or updating files, reload MCP in this client or restart it; an existing server process can still use an older build.

data.name: HealthCheck
data.value: In the selected client, call mcp_health_check with the intended Navisworks host/model open. If it fails, inspect mcp_recent_calls; after a timed-out operation use last_operation_status. Doctor does not make these calls.

data.name: Usage
data.value: Use --doctor --clients <one-id> [--json]. Choose one client explicitly; do not combine doctor with --detect, --configure, --remove, --dry-run, --create-missing or --mcp-server.

data.name: VerifyLauncher
data.value: Check that the configured dotnet launcher resolves to the intended .NET runtime. Doctor reads the server DLL without executing that launcher.
